params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Required. The name of the context. Format: projects/<Project ID>/agent/sessions/<Session ID>/contexts/<Context ID> or projects/<Project ID>/agent/environments/<Environment ID>/users/<User ID>/sessions/<Session ID>/contexts/<Context ID>. If Environment ID is not specified, we assume default 'draft' environment. If User ID is not specified, we assume default '-' user.
